title.en: An Act Declaring June 23 of Every Year as a Special Working Holiday and No Class Day in Schools in the City of Bacoor to Commemorate Its Anniversary as a City

text.en: June 23 of every year is hereby declared as a special working holiday and no class day in schools in the City of Bacoor to commemorate its anniversary as a City.
For work performed on a special working holiday, an employee is entitled to his/her regular wage.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
